verdict.rationale: Configurable cloud environments are a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence never shows Cline letting you define a reproducible cloud environment with repository dependencies and setup steps. Kanban worktrees are local git isolation, running headlessly in GitHub Actions relies on the host pipeline platform, and Skills are instruction sets; none of these is a configurable cloud environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
